'''Prewb Abias''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] in [[the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. He was present during the [[rakghoul pandemic]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] specializing as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]] for THORN volunteers affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
